blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Camera-LiDAR pairs installed as fixed infrastructure need periodic recalibration, but a calibration target takes the installation out of service. We present FGSCalib, a targetless method that calibrates a stationary camera-LiDAR pair from the objects moving in its view. We only assume that arbitrary moving objects are present in the scene: each sensor separates the moving foreground from the static background, without relying on object classes. With the correct extrinsic, the LiDAR foreground points project onto the camera foreground. FGSCalib turns the camera mask into a boundary-proximity field and finds the extrinsic by two-stage simulated annealing over selected frame pairs. It needs no measured initial extrinsic (random starts give similar results) and works with both rotating and non-repetitive LiDARs. We evaluate it on 21 simulated scenarios with exact ground truth and on 72 real ones (nine camera-LiDAR pairs in eight scenes), with a reference averaged from 43 manual calibrations. In simulation the median error is 5.3 cm and 0.19°. On real data we use a tolerance of 18 cm and 1.8°, met by 93% of single manual calibrations. Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, FGSCalib meets it in 51 of the 72 scenarios: in 20 of 24 with the Livox, where the strongest of five baselines reaches 11, and in 31 of 48 with the two rotating LiDARs, where only one baseline estimate does. Its median error is 9.5 cm and 0.9°, against 7.3 cm and 0.7° for a single manual calibration. The code and the dataset are available online.
blocks.zh: 作为固定基础设施安装的相机-LiDAR配对需要定期重新校准,但校准目标使安装失去服务. 我们提出FGSCalib,一种无目标方法,从它视线中移动的物体校准一对固定相机-LiDAR对. 我们只假设场景中存在任意移动的物体:每个传感器将移动的前缘与静态背景分开,而不依赖于物体类. 有了正确的外观,LiDAR前缘点工程在镜头前缘. FGSCalib将相机遮罩转换成边界近似场,通过在选定的帧对上进行两阶段模拟反射来发现外星. 它不需要经过测量的初始外部(随机开始产生类似的结果),并与旋转和非重复的LiDARs合作。 我们用21个模拟场景和72个真实场景(8个场景中的9个相机-LiDAR对)来评价它,从43个手动校准中得出参考平均值. 在模拟中位误差为5.3厘米和0.19°. 在真实数据上,我们使用18厘米和1.8°的耐受度,得到93%的单手校准。 FGSCalib保持5次运行的最低成本,在72次假设中的51次:24次运行中的20次运行中,5次基线中最强者达到11次运行中,48次运行中的31次运行中,2次运行中,只有一次基线估计。 其中位误差为9.5cm和0.9°,而单手校准误差为7.3cm和0.7°. 代码和数据集可在线查阅.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Camera–LiDAR pairs are increasingly mounted at fixed vantage points to observe moving scenes, for traffic and infrastructure monitoring [ 1 ] , public-space sensing [ 2 ] and surveillance [ 3 ] . Integrating the visual information captured by the camera with the geometric data of the LiDAR (light detection and ranging) sensor requires the rigid extrinsic transformation between their coordinate systems, whose error every fused measurement inherits [ 4 ] . Vibration, thermal cycling and occasional disturbance change this transformation over the life of an installation [ 5 ] , and re-establishing it with a calibration target means bringing the target to the mount and taking the installation out of service. What such sites do have, continuously, is moving objects in view; this paper turns them into the calibration signal.
blocks.zh: 相机-LiDAR双相机越来越多地被安装在固定的站点上,以观察移动场景,用于交通和基础设施监测[1],公共-空间感知[2]和监视[3]. 将相机所捕捉到的可视信息与LiDAR(光探测和测距)传感器的几何数据相融合,需要在其坐标系统之间进行刚性外向变换,而其每次被引信测量的出错都继承了[4]. 振动、热循环和偶发扰动在安装寿命期间改变了这种转变,并用校正目标重新建立它意味着将目标送入上架并停止安装。 这样的站点所具备的就是在视线内移动物体;这张纸把它们变成校正信号.

blocks.en: Existing methods are less well suited to this setting. Target-based methods match the known geometry of artificial markers across the sensors [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] ; they are accurate but need manual effort and controlled conditions [ 9 ] . Targetless methods exploit scene features [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] , semantic segmentation [ 9 , 13 , 14 ] , motion trajectories [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] or learned representations [ 19 , 20 ] , and most of them rely on static scene content through which the sensor moves [ 21 ] . A stationary installation never moves, and its static background may have little structure, such as a plain wall, or be hidden by the moving objects that dominate its view. Few methods use moving objects seen by stationary sensors: Jang et al. [ 22 ] calibrate a traffic-surveillance camera–LiDAR pair from the edges of passing vehicles, and Glas et al. [ 2 ] a network of range sensors from tracked pedestrians.
blocks.zh: 现有方法不太适合这种环境。 基于目标的方法与传感器上已知的人工标记的几何相匹配[6, 7, 8];这些方法是准确的,但需要人工努力和控制的条件[9]. 无目标方法利用场景特征[10,11,12],语义分化[9,13,14],运动轨迹[15,16,17,18]或所学表现[19,20],大多数都依靠感应器移动的静态场景内容[21]. 固定安装从不移动,其静态背景可能结构很少,如平面墙,或者被占据其视野的移动物体所隐藏. 很少方法使用固定传感器看到的移动物体: 张等. [22]校正一个交通监视相机 - LiDAR配对出自过往车辆的边缘,和Glas等. [2]一个射程传感器网络 从跟踪行人。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce FGSCalib (Foreground-Segmentation Calibration), a method for estimating the extrinsic calibration of a stationary camera–LiDAR pair using moving objects observed simultaneously by both sensors. Moving objects appear as foreground pixels in the camera images and as foreground points in the corresponding LiDAR sweeps. When the sensors are correctly calibrated, the projected LiDAR foreground points should spatially align with the foreground regions in the camera images.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了FGSCalib(Foreground-Segmentation Calculation),这是一种利用两个传感器同时观测到的移动物体来估计固定相机外出校正的方法-LiDAR配对. 移动对象在相机图像中作为前地像素出现,在相应的LiDAR扫描中作为前地点出现. 当传感器正确校正时,所投射的LiDAR前地点应与相机图像中的前地区域在空间上相通.

blocks.en: Unlike approaches based on object tracking or trajectory correspondence, FGSCalib does not require explicit object associations. Instead, we employ background modelling to extract foreground information independently from both sensor modalities, without relying on predefined object classes. For LiDAR foreground extraction, the method adopts the model introduced in our previous work [ 3 ] . The extrinsic transformation is then estimated by optimising the alignment between the camera and LiDAR foreground observations across multiple time instances (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 与基于物体跟踪或轨迹对应的方法不同,FGSCalib不要求有明确的物体关联. 相反,我们使用背景建模来从两种传感器模式中独立提取前景信息,而不依赖于预先定义的对象类. 对于LiDAR前地取出,该方法采用了我们前作中引入的模式[3]. 然后通过优化相机和LiDAR前地观测在多个时间实例中的对齐度来估计外部变换(图1 )。

blocks.en: LiDAR-based foreground detection faces challenges that differ between LiDAR types. Rotating multi-beam (RMB) LiDARs acquire measurements at fixed elevation angles, producing sparse and repetitive scan rings when the sensor remains stationary. In contrast, non-repetitive circular scanning (NRCS) LiDARs follow a scanning pattern that progressively increases the spatial coverage over time, enabling the accumulation of high-resolution point clouds without moving the sensor. However, achieving sufficient temporal resolution for detecting moving objects requires short integration times, resulting in sparse foreground measurements. Thus, foreground extraction involves balancing spatial coverage and temporal resolution while maintaining an accurate background model, as introduced in [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 基于LiDAR的前地探测面临不同类型的挑战. 旋转多波束(RMB)LiDARs在固定高角度上获得测量,在传感器保持静止时产生稀有和重复的扫描环. 相形之下,非重复循环扫描(NRCS)LiDARs遵循了扫描模式,随着时间的推移,空间覆盖度逐渐增加,使得高分辨点云的积累不移动传感器. 然而,要达到足够的时间分辨率来探测移动物体,需要很短的集成时间,导致前地测量很少. 因此,前景提取涉及平衡空间覆盖面和时间分辨率,同时保持[3]所引入的准确背景模型。

blocks.en: The methods presented in [ 10 , 11 ] require dense point clouds, which, for RMB LiDARs, can only be obtained by moving the sensor during data acquisition. However, sensor motion prevents the reliable detection of moving objects through background modelling. Therefore, FGSCalib performs foreground–background segmentation directly on the sparse LiDAR point clouds acquired by a stationary sensor, in which moving objects are still sampled as they cross the scan rings.
blocks.zh: [10,11]中介绍的方法需要密集点云,对于人民币LiDARs来说,只有在数据采集过程中通过移动传感器才能得到. 然而,传感器运动阻止了通过背景建模对移动物体的可靠检测. 因此,FGSCalib在静止传感器获得的稀疏的LiDAR点云上直接进行前地-后地分解,其中移动物体在穿过扫描环时仍被取样.

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed approach using three LiDAR sensors representing two distinct scanning principles: the Velodyne VLP-16 and the Ouster OS1-64, which are RMB LiDARs with 16 and 64 scan rings, respectively, and the Livox Avia, an NRCS LiDAR.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个代表两种不同扫描原理的LiDAR传感器来评价拟议方法:Velodyne VLP-16和Ouster OS1-64,分别为人民币LiDARs和64个扫描环;Livox Avia是NRCS LiDAR。

blocks.en: FGSCalib assumes that (i) the camera and the LiDAR are rigidly mounted with fields of view that overlap where objects move; (ii) the camera intrinsics are known; (iii) each camera image can be paired with the LiDAR sweep nearest to it in time, giving a sequence of frame pairs ; and (iv) the recording contains moving objects. The search needs no measured initial extrinsic, only a box of poses that contains the true one. We start it from the nominal pose (zero translation, both sensors facing the same way); random starts in the box give similar results (Sec. V-A ). Real recordings have no ground truth, so we build a reference from repeated manual calibrations and derive the tolerance from how well they agree (Secs. IV-C and IV-D ).
blocks.zh: FGSCalib假设(一)相机和LiDAR被刚性地安装了与物体移动时相重叠的视域; (二)相机的内在是已知的; (三)每个相机图像可以与相机最近的LiDAR扫描成对,给出了帧对的顺序; (四)所录入的相机包含有移动对象. 搜索不需要测量初始外观, 只需要包含真实外观的一箱外观 。 我们从名义姿势开始(0个翻译,两种传感器都面对同样的方式);在盒子中随机起步给出类似的结果(Sec. V-A.). 真实的录音没有事实根据,因此我们从反复的手工校正中建立参考,并从他们同意的程度(四-C和四-D)中获得容忍度。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are: • FGSCalib, a targetless calibration method for stationary camera–LiDAR pairs that uses moving foreground as its signal, through a boundary-proximity field derived from the camera mask and a two-stage simulated-annealing search over a box of poses. It needs no target, platform motion, object class or measured initial extrinsic (random starts anywhere in the box give results similar to the nominal start), and it works with both RMB and NRCS LiDARs. • Diversity-aware frame-pair selection (DFPS), a target-free rule that chooses the frame pairs used by the search from the foreground segmentations of the two sensors alone; in our ablation it lowers the largest rotation errors. • A new benchmark of 21 simulated and 72 real scenarios with three LiDARs of two scanning principles (RMB and NRCS) and three cameras, with 43 manual calibration sessions that give the real-data reference, its uncertainty, and a tolerance derived from how closely single sessions agree. The benchmark is released with this paper. To our knowledge, it is the first public camera–LiDAR benchmark that provides several independent manual calibrations per sensor pair, which are needed to measure the uncertainty of the reference. • An evaluation against manual calibration and five targetless baselines, with a multi-seed ablation: on real data, with the lowest-cost of five runs, FGSCalib is within the tolerance in 20 of 24 scenarios with the Livox and in 31 of 48 with the RMB LiDARs, where the baselines reach 11 and 1; on static recordings, where FGSCalib cannot run, a static-scene baseline reaches it in 11 of 12.
blocks.zh: 本作的主要贡献有: • FGSCalib,一种定点相机的无目标校正方法-LiDAR对相机采用移动前地作为信号,通过相机口罩所衍生出的一个相机近地场和用一盒相机进行两相模拟-安放搜索. 它不需要目标,平台运动,物体类或被测量的初始外延(随机从盒子的任何地方起算,结果类似于名义起算),它与人民币和NRCS LiDARs同时工作. • 多样性-意识框架- Pair 选择 (DFPS),一种无目标规则,它从两个传感器的前地分解中选择搜索所使用的框架对;在我们看来,它降低了最大的自转错误。 二. 支助 21个模拟和72个真实情景的新基准,配有两个扫描原理(RMB和NRCS)和三个相机的3个LiDAR,配有43个手动校正会话,给出了真实数据的参考,它的不确定性,以及从单个会话如何接近一致而得到的能耐. 基准随本文一并发布. 据我们所知,这是第一个公共相机——LiDAR基准,每对传感器提供若干独立的手动校正,这是衡量参考的不确定性所需要的。 对照人工校准和5个无目标基线进行评估,采用多种子计分法:在真实数据,成本最低的5个跑道中,FGSCalib在与Livox的24个场景中的20个场景中处于耐受度范围内,在48个场景中的31个场景中,基线达到11个和1个;在静态录音中,FGSCalib无法运行的场景基线在12个场景中的11个场景中达到耐受度.

It needs no target, platform motion, object class or measured initial extrinsic (random starts anywhere in the box give results similar to the nominal start), and it works with both RMB and NRCS LiDARs.

blocks.en: A new benchmark of 21 simulated and 72 real scenarios with three LiDARs of two scanning principles (RMB and NRCS) and three cameras, with 43 manual calibration sessions that give the real-data reference, its uncertainty, and a tolerance derived from how closely single sessions agree. blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Surveys of camera–LiDAR calibration are given in [ 4 , 21 ] ; here we focus on targetless methods.
blocks.zh: 对相机的测量 - LiDAR 校正在 [4, 21] 中给出;这里我们侧重于无目标方法.

blocks.en: II-A Methods That Do Not Use Scene Motion
blocks.zh: II-A 不使用场景动作的方法

blocks.en: Most targetless methods rely on static scene structure and assume that the scene remains unchanged across the calibration frames, with any apparent motion caused only by the sensor platform. Moving objects therefore contribute no useful information to them and can disrupt the correspondences they rely on.
blocks.zh: 大多数无目标方法都依赖于静态场景结构,并假设场景在整个校正框架上保持不变,任何明显的运动都是由传感器平台所造成. 因此,移动物体不会给它们带来有用的信息,而且会破坏它们依赖的通信。

blocks.en: These methods extract geometrically corresponding primitives from both modalities. Koide et al. [ 10 ] convert LiDAR intensity measurements into a virtual image and use SuperGlue [ 23 ] to establish 2D–3D keypoint correspondences, which are then refined by normalised information distance. The method requires LiDAR-intensity texture and a dense point cloud, so an RMB LiDAR must be moved during the recording to accumulate enough points. Yuan et al. [ 11 ] match depth-continuous point-cloud edges against Canny image edges under an explicit LiDAR noise model; the method reaches pixel-level accuracy in scenes with well-defined planar edges but requires an initial estimate of the extrinsic.
blocks.zh: 这些方法从两种模式中提取出几何对应的原始. 柯德等编. [10]将LiDAR强度测量转换为虚拟图像,并使用SuperGlue [23]建立2D–3D键点对应,然后由正态信息距离来完善. 该方法需要LiDAR-强度纹理和密集点云,因此在录音过程中必须移动一款人民币LiDAR来积累足够的分数. 袁等编. blocks.en: These methods align corresponding regions rather than sparse features. Zhu et al. [ 24 ] segment obstacle classes in the camera image and turn the mask into a smooth map, which they call a height map, decaying inside and outside each obstacle region under an exponential kernel of the Manhattan ( ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ) distance; an extrinsic is scored by the map values at the projected non-ground LiDAR points. This formulation is the most closely related to our proposed boundary-proximity field, with the key differences discussed in Sec. III-B . Sun et al. [ 14 ] associate vehicle instances across the two modalities with the Hungarian algorithm and score an extrinsic by a distance-transform mask match plus instance-centroid distances, refining an initial estimate from hand–eye calibration. SemAlign [ 9 ] and SST-Calib [ 13 ] optimise differentiable losses over same-class projections. These four methods all require predefined semantic classes to be present in the scene.
blocks.zh: 这些方法符合相应的区域而不是稀有的特点。 朱等编. [24]相机图像中的分段障碍分级,将口罩变成平滑地图,他们称之为高地图,在曼哈顿(l 1\ell\1}})相距的指数内核下,每个障碍区内外都衰变;在所预测的非地上LiDAR点上,由地图值得分. 这一提法与我们提议的边界-相近地段关系最密切,主要分歧在Sec.III-B.中讨论。 孙等. [14] 将跨越两种模式的车辆实例与匈牙利算法联系起来,通过远距离变形口罩相匹配加实例-中心机器人相距而得分,完善了手-眼校正的初步估计。 SemAlign [9] 和 SST-Calib [13] 将不同损失优化于同级预测. 这四种方法都要求预定义的语义课出现在现场.

blocks.en: Calib-Anything [ 25 ] and PAIRS-Calib [ 26 ] eliminate the need for predefined object classes by employing class-agnostic segmentation. Calib-Anything uses the Segment Anything Model to segment the camera images and refines an initial calibration estimate by maximising the consistency of the projected LiDAR points within each segment in terms of intensity, surface normals, and segment categories. The method is demonstrated primarily on static driving scenes. PAIRS-Calib aligns class-agnostic boundary masks extracted from camera images and from LiDAR depth and intensity representations using stochastic approximation, searching within a bounded region around an initial calibration estimate. It is evaluated on recordings acquired from a moving vehicle, with initial calibration errors of at most 2.5 ∘ 2.5^{\circ} in rotation and 0.25 m in translation. A direct experimental comparison with PAIRS-Calib was not possible, as its implementation has not been made publicly available.
blocks.zh: Calib-Anything [25] and PAIRS-Calib [26] 通过使用类不可知分来消除预先定义对象类的需要. Calib-Anything使用分片Anything模型来分片相机图像并改进初步校正估计,从强度,地表常态,分片类别等角度尽可能地使每个分片内预测的LiDAR点保持一致. 这种方法主要在静态驱动场景中展示. PAIRS-Calib将从相机图像取自的类不可知边界口罩和从LiDAR深度和强度表示中取自的相机近似值进行校正,围绕初步校正估计在一个有界区域内进行搜索. 它根据从移动车辆获得的录音加以评价,初始校正误差最多为:旋转2.5- 2.5- Circ}和翻译0.25米。 无法与PAIRS-Calib进行直接的实验比较,因为其执行情况尚未公布。

blocks.en: Approaches such as CalibNet [ 27 ] , RegNet [ 19 ] , LCCNet [ 20 ] , and CMRNext [ 28 ] , which builds on RAFT [ 29 ] , employ neural networks to estimate the extrinsic transformation directly or to establish dense pixel-to-point correspondences. Their publicly available models are primarily trained on driving datasets acquired with RMB LiDAR sensors. Although CMRNext has demonstrated generalisation to previously unseen sensors, the performance of learning-based approaches remains dependent on the distribution of their training data [ 30 ] . Adapting these methods to new sensor configurations typically requires retraining with substantial amounts of data annotated with ground-truth extrinsic parameters. In contrast, 3DGS-Calib [ 31 ] avoids the need for labelled training data by leveraging Gaussian Splatting, but requires camera motion within a static environment to construct its scene representation.
blocks.zh: CalibNet [27],RegNet [19],LCCNet [20],和CMRNext [28] 等方法以RAFT[29]为基础,利用神经网络直接估计外向变换,或建立密集的像素到点对应. 他们的可公开使用的模型主要接受使用人民币LiDAR传感器获取的驱动数据集的培训. 虽然CMRNext对以前不见的传感器表现出了通俗化,但基于学习的方法的性能仍然取决于其培训数据的分布[30]. 要使这些方法适应新的传感器配置,通常需要再培训,需要大量附有地面真实外部参数的数据。 相形之下,3DGS-Calib [31]通过利用高斯平板电脑避免了对被标注的训练数据的需要,但需要相机在静态环境中运动来构建其场景表现.

blocks.en: These approaches estimate the extrinsic transformation by aligning the sensor ego-motion trajectories independently estimated from camera and LiDAR measurements as the sensor platform moves [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . However, moving objects in the environment may compromise the accuracy of these motion estimates, and the methods are inherently unsuitable for stationary sensor configurations.
blocks.zh: 这些方法通过将传感器自负-运动轨迹从相机和LiDAR测量中独立估算出来,随着传感器平台的移动[15、16、17、18],对外部变化作出估计。 然而,在环境中移动的物体可能会损害这些运动估计的准确性,这些方法在本质上不适合固定传感器的配置.

blocks.en: II-B Methods Exploiting the Motion of Scene Objects
blocks.zh: II-B 探索景物运动的方法

blocks.en: A smaller subset of methods instead exploits the motion of objects in the scene to estimate the extrinsic calibration. Glas et al. [ 2 ] calibrate a network of stationary 3D range sensors rather than a camera–LiDAR pair; they detect and track pedestrians across the sensors and align the resulting trajectories, which makes the method dependent on the presence of pedestrians in the scene. Peršić et al. [ 32 ] also exploit moving objects for calibration by tracking their motion from a mobile sensor platform. However, their approach requires explicit object tracking and estimates only the rotational component of the extrinsic transformation. Jang et al. [ 22 ] calibrate a fixed traffic-surveillance camera–LiDAR pair from passing vehicles. Similarly to our approach, their method identifies moving objects in both sensor modalities through class-free background subtraction. It then extracts the edges of the vehicles and estimates the extrinsic transformation by maximising the kernel correlation between projected LiDAR edge points and camera edge pixels using a genetic algorithm. The optimisation is initialised with candidate transformations sampled within twice the initial calibration error, and the method is evaluated with initial errors of up to 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} and 1 m using 40- and 64-channel RMB LiDARs. Although both approaches exploit foreground information from moving objects, they differ in two important aspects. First, FGSCalib evaluates the alignment of entire foreground regions rather than relying exclusively on object boundaries, making use of foreground measurements even when sparse LiDAR sweeps provide limited boundary information. Second, FGSCalib optimises over a predefined pose range without requiring a measured initial calibration estimate, whereas [ 22 ] defines its search space relative to an initial pose. These differences are particularly relevant with sparse LiDAR observations and limited prior calibration information. A direct experimental comparison was not possible because the implementation of [ 22 ] is not publicly available.
blocks.zh: 取而代之的是比较小的子集方法利用场景中物体的运动来估计外延校正. 格拉斯等译. [2]校正由固定的3D射程传感器组成的网络,而不是相机-LiDAR对;它们检测并跟踪行人穿过传感器并调整所形成的轨迹,这使得方法依赖于行人在场在现场. 佩尔希奇等人案 [32]还利用移动物体通过从移动传感器平台跟踪其运动来进行校正. 然而,它们的处理方法需要明确的物体跟踪和仅估计外生变换的旋转部分。 张等. [22]校正一对从过往车辆取来的固定交通监视相机-LiDAR对. 与我们的方法类似,它们的方法通过无级背景减法在两种传感器模式中识别出移动物体。 然后它利用基因算法将预测的LiDAR边缘点和相机边缘像素之间的内核关联最大化,从而提取出飞行器的边缘并估计出外核变换. 优化后在初始校正误差的两倍内抽取候选变相,并使用40道和64道人民币LiDARs对方法进行初始误差最高为10-Q-10-Circ}和1米的评价. 虽然这两种方法都利用了移动物体的地表信息,但它们在两个重要方面有所不同. 首先,FGSCalib评价整个前地区域的相接性,而不是完全依赖对象边界,即使稀少的LiDAR扫描提供了有限的边界信息,也要利用前地测量. 第二,FGSCalib在不要求计量初始校正估计的情况下,对预先定义的外观范围进行选择,而[22]则将其搜索空间相对于初始外观加以界定。 这些差异与稀少的LiDAR观测和有限的事先校正信息特别相关. 由于无法公开实施[22],因此无法进行直接的实验比较。

blocks.en: While these approaches typically rely on additional assumptions or prior information, FGSCalib estimates the full camera–LiDAR extrinsic transformation from class-free foreground observations of moving objects, without requiring sensor motion, explicit object correspondences, or a measured initial extrinsic estimate.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些方法通常依赖附加的假设或事先的信息,但FGSCalib估计全相机-LiDAR外观变化,即从对移动物体的无级前地观测中进行,而不需要传感器运动、明确的物体对应关系或测量的初步外观估计。

blocks.en: II-C Data Selection for Calibration
blocks.zh: II-C 校正数据选择

blocks.en: Camera–LiDAR calibration typically relies on multiple frame pairs collected over time. However, not all observations are equally informative for estimating the extrinsic transformation, and many existing approaches either use all available frames or select a subset randomly. In target-based calibration, Tsai et al. [ 33 ] address this issue by ranking chessboard observations according to their orientation diversity and detection accuracy. Their approach, however, relies on a known calibration target. In contrast, FGSCalib introduces a target-free frame selection strategy that scores each frame pair directly from the foreground segmentations of both sensors, favouring pairs that differ in where and at what depth the foreground appears (Sec. III-C ).
blocks.zh: 相机-LiDAR校正一般依赖于随时间所收集的多帧对. 然而,并非所有观测结果都同样有助于估计外部变化,许多现有方法要么使用所有可用的框架,要么随机选择一个子集。 在基于目标的校正中,Tsai等. [33]通过根据棋盘观测的定向多样性和检测准确性进行排名来解决这一问题. 然而,它们的方法依赖于已知的校准目标。 相形之下,FGSCalib引入了无目标帧选择策略,直接从两个传感器的前地分出每个帧对分,偏好在前地出现地点和深度上不同的对分(Sec. III-C.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: FGSCalib has four steps (Fig. 1 b–d): foreground segmentation in both sensors (Sec. III-A ), the boundary-proximity field and the cost defined on it (Sec. III-B ), frame-pair selection (Sec. III-C ) and a two-stage simulated-annealing search (Sec. III-D ).
blocks.zh: FGSCalib有4个步骤(图1b-d):两个传感器的前地分割(Sec. III-A),边界-相邻场及其所定义的成本(Sec. III-B),帧-相接选择(Sec. III-C)和两相模拟-相接搜索(Sec. III-D).

blocks.en: III-A Foreground Segmentation for Camera and LiDAR Data
blocks.zh: III-A 相机和LiDAR数据前景分解

blocks.en: We use an improved Gaussian-mixture background model (mixture of Gaussians, MoG) [ 34 ] with its standard settings, which classifies each pixel over time as foreground or background and gives a binary mask M M per frame. Pixels that MoG labels as shadow are treated as background. We apply no further post-processing to the masks, not even the removal of small connected foreground regions ( components ), because the field of Sec. III-B limits the influence of small spurious components. The rest of the pipeline uses only these masks, so another foreground segmenter could in principle replace MoG.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个经过改进的高斯-混合背景模型(高斯人混合,MOG)[34]及其标准设置,将每个像素随时间推移分类为前地或后地,每个帧给出一个二进制口罩M. 将MOG标签为"阴影"的像素视为背景. 我们不再对口罩进行后处理,甚至不再去除小型连接的前缘区域(组件),因为Sec. III-B领域限制了小型假组件的影响. 其余管道仅使用这些口罩,因此另一个前地分机原则上可以取代MOG.

blocks.en: We use the LiDAR foreground model of our previous work [ 3 ] , an adaptation of the Stauffer–Grimson mixture model [ 35 ] to range measurements. An RMB LiDAR returns one range per elevation channel and azimuth step, so its output already forms a regular lattice in which each cell is one fixed viewing direction; the points of an NRCS LiDAR, or of an RMB LiDAR whose driver outputs an unordered cloud, are binned by azimuth and elevation into a lattice of the same form. Each cell keeps a mixture of five Gaussian modes over the ranges measured in its direction, updated online with each sweep, and the mode with the largest weight gives the background range of the cell. A return that matches this component is background and updates the model. Three rules adapt the model to moving objects and to sparse, jittering returns. A return clearly in front of the background range is foreground and leaves the model unchanged, so an object that stops is not absorbed into the background. A return that matches the background of any cell in its 3 × 3 3{\times}3 neighbourhood is background, which absorbs beam jitter and, for the NRCS LiDAR, the binning. On the real data, a return close to a stable second mode of its cell is also background, as on object edges where a cell alternates between two surfaces. Returns closer than 1.2 m are discarded, and the constants are in the supplement (Sec. S2). The output is, for each frame pair s s , a set of foreground points P s L P^{L}_{s} (Fig. 1 b, Fig. 2d ), and a frame pair enters the candidate pool , from which Sec. III-C selects, whenever its LiDAR foreground is non-empty.

blocks.en: IV-A Simulated Dataset
blocks.zh: 模拟数据集

blocks.en: We place virtual sensors in the CARLA simulator [ 42 ] and derive the camera–LiDAR extrinsic from their known poses, so the simulated ground truth is exact; the nominal start is 19 to 61 cm and 3.4 ∘ 3.4^{\circ} to 6.7 ∘ 6.7^{\circ} from it. We simulate a 16-channel and a 64-channel RMB LiDAR (labelled 16-channel and 64-channel where the tables split them) and an NRCS LiDAR with the rosette pattern of the Livox Avia, and record 600 frames at 10 Hz at each of 7 fixed sensor placements in CARLA’s Town10HD map with moving pedestrians and vehicles.
blocks.zh: 我们把虚拟传感器放入CARLA模拟器 [42] 中,并从已知的姿势中衍生出相机-LiDAR外接器,因此模拟出地面的真伪是准确的;名义起步是19至61厘米和3.4 ∘ 3.4^{\ Circ}从它得到6.7∘ 6.7^{\ Circ}. 我们模拟一个16道和64道人民币LiDAR(标有16道和64道的平分表)和一个带有Livox Avia的玫瑰花纹图案的NRCS LiDAR,并在CARLA的Town10HD地图中的7个固定传感器放置处分别记录了以10赫兹为单位的600帧和行人和车辆。

blocks.en: IV-B Real Dataset
blocks.zh: 四-B 实际数据集

blocks.en: We recorded 8 scenes with one rig: a narrow indoor corridor, an open courtyard, urban streets, a busy square, a staircase, and plain-wall backgrounds. The foreground objects (pedestrians, vehicles, trams, a quadruped robot and a drone) are deliberately varied, since the method uses no object class. The scenes range from an easy one, a staircase with a person and a robot, to deliberately hard ones: plain walls with little static structure, a single small drone, a short recording of a crowded square with trams and cars, and a street with cars. Three LiDARs and three cameras on a stationary platform, not reassembled between recordings, give nine sensor pairs per scene and 72 scenarios. All three LiDARs deliver 10 sweeps per second, so a sweep of the NRCS LiDAR integrates 100 ms. We use only one RGB stream of each camera, with no stereo or depth; a scenario provides a few hundred candidate frame pairs, fewer in the short recording of the square. Four further recordings with the same rig contain no moving objects; FGSCalib cannot use them, and they serve only to run the static-scene baselines in their own conditions.

blocks.en: IV-C Reference Calibration and Its Uncertainty
blocks.zh: IV-C 参考校正及其不确定性

blocks.en: The real recordings have no exact ground truth. Our reference is the average of independent manual calibrations: 43 sessions (3–6 per sensor pair) with the Autoware toolkit [ 43 ] , each from a different recording: seven with a calibration board and 36 with correspondences picked by hand on natural features in the scene recordings. The sessions of a sensor pair deviate from their mean by an RMS deviation s s (Euclidean in translation, geodesic in rotation, n − 1 n{-}1 degrees of freedom) whose median over the nine sensor pairs is 9.4 cm and 0.88 ∘ 0.88^{\circ} (supplement, Sec. S10); as the sessions use different recordings, s s describes reproducibility rather than repeatability [ 44 ] . blocks.en: An estimate is within tolerance when it is within 18 cm and 1.8 ∘ 1.8^{\circ} , both bounds required. The bound comes from the manual sessions. blocks.en: Most FGSCalib estimates are as close to the reference as single manual calibrations are (Fig. 4 ). Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, a rule that needs no reference, FGSCalib is within tolerance in 51 of the 72 scenarios, with all three LiDARs, and none of the 72 estimates is a failure (Table II ). Its errors are somewhat larger than those of a single manual session, mostly in rotation: 18 of its 72 estimates are more than 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} off, against one of the 43 sessions. In simulation, with exact ground truth, it is within tolerance in 81 of 84 runs (Table IV (a), row 5).

blocks.en: Accuracy depends on the scene. Cars move fastest there, and for them the time offset between image and sweep likely matters most (Sec. VII ). On the two plain-wall scenes, where static-scene methods find little structure, it is within tolerance in 13 of 18 scenarios. The weakest sensor pairs are the Ouster with the RealSense 2 and with the ZED 2i (Table III ). Fig. 5 shows the median scenario of three sensor pairs.

blocks.en: Each baseline runs in its recommended configuration on the same recordings. Koide et al. computes its own initial guess; the other baselines start, like FGSCalib, from the nominal pose (Yuan et al. also from coarse starts), which lies 12 to 28 cm and 1.2 ∘ 1.2^{\circ} to 19 ∘ 19^{\circ} from the reference and, by chance, inside the tolerance for ZED 2i–Livox. LCCNet is trained for such errors, while CMRNext and Calib-Anything expect at most 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} , which the nominal pose exceeds for some sensor pairs. Our recordings lie outside the training domain of the learned methods, so Table II tests them only there; their accuracy within that domain is reported in their own papers.

blocks.en: With the Livox, Koide et al. also reaches the tolerance in many scenarios among moving objects, and Yuan et al. in some from a coarse start; with the RMB LiDARs only FGSCalib does (Table II ). The Livox’s NRCS pattern fills in a dense image of the static background over time. With it Koide et al.’s median error is inside the tolerance, and FGSCalib is within tolerance in more scenarios (20 against 11 of 24); Yuan et al., started within ± 5 ∘ \pm 5^{\circ} and ± 10 \pm 10 cm of the reference (a coarse start, which uses the reference), is within it in 6 of 30 runs. A stationary RMB LiDAR gives only a sparse point cloud, and Koide et al. fails with it on the static recordings as well (24 of 24), which points to the sparse cloud, not the moving objects, as the cause. With these LiDARs FGSCalib is within tolerance in 31 of 48 scenarios, and of all baseline estimates only one is. The released learned models did not transfer to this rig; LCCNet fails in every scenario.

blocks.en: Table IV shows which parts of FGSCalib produce these results. Repeating a configuration with another seed changes the error of a simulated scenario by a median of 0.9 cm / 0.05 ∘ 0.05^{\circ} and the median of a row of Table IV (a) by 0.5 to 2.1 cm, so differences of that size are not resolved by this experiment. Four further variants of the field (no limit on the attraction radius, one radius for all components, the inside profile alone, and a linear outside profile) are in the supplement (Sec. S5); none is clearly better than ours, and the linear and logarithmic outside profiles cannot be told apart.
blocks.zh: 表四显示FGSCalib的哪些部分产生这些结果。 重复一个配置与另一个种子会改变模拟场景的误差为中位数为0.9 cm/0.05 → 0.05 → Circ}而一行表四 (a)的中位数为0.5到2.1 cm,因此这个大小的相差不由这个实验解决. 域外再有四个变体(吸引力半径没有限制,所有组件都有一个半径,单是内侧剖面,还有线性外侧剖面)在补充(Sec. S5)中;没有任何一个明显优于我们的外侧剖面,线性外侧剖面和对数外侧剖面无法区分.

blocks.en: The field and the binary mask reach the same median error; the mask has more large errors. In simulation the medians of the five rows differ by about the rerun variation. Under either selection rule the mask has more runs above 20 cm than the field, 9 against 2 with DFPS (eight of the nine in the two RMB-LiDAR scenarios of one scene) and 3 against none with random selection, and fewer runs within tolerance; with the field the mean Δ ​ t \Delta t is lower and its spread smaller. On real data the mask is within tolerance slightly more often and has a lower median Δ ​ R \Delta R , but it fails twice as often and its largest error is more than twice as large (Table IV (b)).

blocks.en: The remaining simulated error is mainly a bias of the cost. Evaluated on their own frame pairs, all 84 runs of row 3 and all 84 of row 5 end at a lower cost F F than the exact ground truth. A local search around ground truth (supplement, Sec. S8) finds a minimum of F F a median of 5.8 cm / 0.19 ∘ 0.19^{\circ} from ground truth with the field and 4.7 cm / 0.12 ∘ 0.12^{\circ} with the mask, offset away from the camera along the viewing axis in 19 and 16 of the 21 scenarios and downwards in the image; the two minima differ in no consistent direction. The runs with the field end a median of 1.8 cm from this minimum, about the resolution of the check, so the search finds the minimum and the cost places it off the ground truth.

blocks.en: The second stage corrects some failures; DFPS lowers the largest rotation errors and the spread of the rotation error. On real data the second stage corrects four of the eleven Stage-1 failures in our 360 runs and introduces none, while the number within tolerance (231 before, 233 after) and the median Δ ​ t \Delta t (9.3 and 9.7 cm) hardly change. In simulation, where no run fails, the median Δ ​ t \Delta t of row 5 falls from the Stage-1 to the final estimate from 6.6 to 5.3 cm, although the 95% interval of this change, from resampling the seven scenes, is − 1.9 -1.9 to + 0.8 +0.8 cm. With the field, DFPS and random selection reach about the same median error (rows 4 and 5); the benefit of DFPS is in the rotation. In simulation it halves the largest rotation error ( 0.58 ∘ 0.58^{\circ} against 1.09 ∘ 1.09^{\circ} ) and narrows the rotation spread ( σ \sigma of 0.11 ∘ 0.11^{\circ} against 0.16 ∘ 0.16^{\circ} ), while the counts within tolerance differ by two runs of 84. On real data, over the same three repeats, its largest errors are 56 cm / 8.1 ∘ 8.1^{\circ} against 73 cm / 10.1 ∘ 10.1^{\circ} and its rotation spread 1.19 ∘ 1.19^{\circ} against 1.42 ∘ 1.42^{\circ} , with 137 against 131 of 216 runs within tolerance and 5 failures each. The number of runs above 20 cm is not reduced (supplement, Sec. S5).

blocks.en: VII Discussion
blocks.zh: 页:1 讨论情况

blocks.en: Moving objects give a stationary rig what it otherwise lacks: correspondences that change over time and cover different image regions and depths, and that even a sparse RMB LiDAR samples, because the objects cross its rings. This is consistent with FGSCalib reaching the tolerance in most scenarios with each of the three LiDARs, while the static-scene baselines are within tolerance only with the Livox, whose NRCS pattern fills in over time. The two kinds of cue are complementary (Sec. V-B ).
blocks.zh: 移动物体提供了它原本缺乏的固定装置:随时间而变化并覆盖不同图像区域和深度的通信,甚至少量人民币LiDAR样本,因为物体跨越了它的环. 这与FGSCalib在大多数情景中与三个LiDAR分别达到耐受性是一致的,而静态-场面基线只有Livox的耐受性,而Livox的NRCS模式随时间而填补. 这两种提示是互补的(Sec.V-B.).

blocks.en: The signal and the global search set the median accuracy, which a plain binary mask already reaches. The field and the second stage reduced gross errors in our tests: with the field the largest real-data error fell from 142 to 56 cm and the simulated runs above 20 cm from 9 to 2 of 84, and the second stage corrected four of the eleven Stage-1 failures on real data without introducing any. For an unattended installation, where a gross error would go unnoticed, this matters more than the median, but the method has no reliable reference-free failure detector yet: the lowest-cost rule avoided every failed run in our data, while among the others G G is a weak guide. What remains in simulation is a bias of the cost of a few centimetres, away from the camera and downwards, and the real estimates are offset away from the camera too; this points to the next step, a cost that also penalises camera foreground left uncovered.
blocks.zh: 信号和全局搜索设置了中位精度,一个平面二进制面具已经到达. 现场和第二阶段降低了我们测试中的重大出错:现场最大的真实数据出错从142公分下降到56公分,模拟时间从84分之9跑到2分之20公分以上,第二阶段纠正了11个阶段-1在真实数据上失败的4分而未引入任何. 对于一个无人看管的安装,当一个总出错会被忽略时,这比中位数更重要,但该方法还没有可靠的无参考故障探测器:最低成本的规则避免了我们数据中的每一个故障运行,而其他GG则是一个薄弱的向导. 模拟中剩下的是几厘米成本的偏差,远离相机而向下,真实的估计也从相机而去抵消;这指向了下一步,这一成本也惩罚了所发现的相机前缘.

blocks.en: All real recordings come from one tripod-mounted rig, with the rotation searched in a ± 20 ∘ \pm 20^{\circ} box. We did not evaluate pole- or gantry-mounted installations, which see objects from farther away, nor remounting; recovery from arbitrary rotations is shown only in simulation (supplement, Sec. S7). Frame pairs were formed by timestamp without hardware triggering: the image and the sweep are a median of 11 ms and at most 103 ms apart, the Livox and Ouster stamps are reception times, and object motion within a sweep is not compensated, which matters most for fast objects such as cars. Some settings were chosen on the real recordings and others on the simulated ones (supplement, Sec. S1), so neither evaluation is fully held out.
blocks.zh: 所有真实的录音都来自一个三脚架钻机, 旋转搜索在一个 ± 20\pm 20\circ} 盒子。 我们没有评估从更远处看到物体的杆或齿轮上架装置,也没有重新上架;从任意自转得到的恢复只在模拟中显示(补充,Sec.S7)。 帧对由时间戳而成而无硬件触发:图像和扫瞄为中位数为11ms,相隔最多为103ms,利沃克和奥克斯特邮票是接收时间,扫瞄范围内的物体运动没有补偿,这对汽车等快件最为重要. 在真实录音上选择了一些设置,在模拟录音上选择了一些设置(补充,Sec. S1),因此两个评价都没有被完全保留.

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八 结论

blocks.en: FGSCalib calibrates a stationary camera–LiDAR pair from whatever moves through its view, with no calibration target, no platform motion and no measured initial extrinsic, and it works with both RMB and NRCS LiDARs. Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, it is within the tolerance that 93% of single manual calibrations meet (18 cm / 1.8 ∘ 1.8^{\circ} ) in 51 of 72 real scenarios, with all three LiDARs: in 20 of 24 with the Livox, where the best baseline reaches 11, and in 31 of 48 with the RMB LiDARs, where only one baseline estimate does. On static recordings, where FGSCalib cannot run, a static-scene method with a dense LiDAR is the right choice. Its median error is 9.5 cm / 0.9 ∘ 0.9^{\circ} , against 7.3 cm / 0.7 ∘ 0.7^{\circ} for a single manual calibration, its larger errors are mostly in rotation, and starting from a random pose in the search box changes the result little. In simulation its median error is 5.3 cm / 0.19 ∘ 0.19^{\circ} ; what remains there is mainly a bias of the cost, away from the camera and downwards, and the real estimates are offset away from the camera too. Future work includes a cost whose minimum lies at the true extrinsic, reference-free confidence estimation, and deployment on pole-mounted infrastructure.
blocks.zh: FGSCalib 校正一个固定相机 - LiDAR配对从其视野中任意移动,没有校正目标,没有站台运动,也没有测量出初始外延,它同时与人民币和NRCS LiDARs合作. 保持最低的5个运行成本,93%的单体手动校正符合72个真实情景中的51个(18 cm / 1.8 ∘ 1.8 ^{\ Circ}),全部3个LiDAR:其中20个与Livox,最佳基线为11个;48个中31个与人民币LiDAR相符合,只有一个基线估计. 在静态录音中,在FGSCalib不能运行的地方,一个带有密集的LiDAR的静态相片方法是正确的选择. 其中位错为9.5 cm / 6.9 + 0.9 + 0.9 + rc},相对于7.3 cm / 0.7 → 0.7 + 7 + rc → 单手校正,其较大出错多为旋转出错,从搜索框中的随机姿势开始,对结果变化不大. 在模拟中位误差为 5.3 cm / 0.19 → 0.19 → Circ};所剩的主要是成本偏差,远离相机而向下,真实的估计数也从相机中被抵消. 今后的工作包括费用,其最低数额取决于真实的外在、无参考依据的信心估计,以及部署在有柱架的基础设施上。
